family: R17-E-agreeweight: agreement-weighted sizing on frozen U1 (votes set SIZE, nothing is dropped)
hypothesis: Round16 UNION filtering is DEAD because it REMOVES trades (v52: monthly 2.935->2.724, extra trades net negative). Different hypothesis: keep every U1 signal, let votes set SIZE — 2 votes 1.0x, 1 vote 0.5x. Single-vote trades risk less capital instead of disappearing; agreement scales exposure without changing coverage/fills ex ante.

union_rule.dedup: one row per (bar_index, direction); union U1 = majority UNION confirmed
union_rule.conflict_priority: majority > confirmed (keep majority row on conflict)
union_rule.geometry: each union member keeps its own frozen geometry; no refit, no recompute
union_rule.hygiene: drop redundant 'action'/'leverage' columns from sources if present; sort union by signal_time; reset index
union_rule.note: overlap recomputed by the driver itself (do not trust memory); ex ante U1_size = n_maj + n_con - intersection

vote_rule.single: key in exactly one set -> leverage 0.5
vote_rule.causal: set membership is known at signal time (both source frames are frozen pre-experiment); no future information

sizing.agreeweight: per-signal leverage from vote_rule (1.0 both / 0.5 single), ExecutionConfig floor 0.25 / max 1.0 so 0.5 passes through engine clamp min(max(requested, 0.25), 1.0)
sizing.agreeweight_dd_guard: per-signal leverage = vote_weight * guard_level; guard_level = 0.5 when majority_control_1x equity of THIS experiment is >10% under trailing peak (past-only, 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed), else 1.0; applied at each signal's own signal_time. Realized levels: both+noguard 1.0, both+guard 0.5, single+noguard 0.5, single+guard 0.25. ExecutionConfig floor 0.25 / max 1.0 lets all four levels pass.

dd_guard_reference: Fresh majority_control_1x run of THIS experiment (exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level. Same formula as scripts/opencode_r1a_holding_probe.py. Guard NEVER removes trades, only scales the vote weight.
control_U1: U1_1x normal must match published v52 U1_1x (total_return 1.4742586857377251, max_drawdown -0.21751346157692608, 66 trades; tol 1e-6) or STOP
control_majority_check: majority_control_1x normal CHECKED (non-fatal) vs published majority_1x (total_return 1.6517829563633004, max_drawdown -0.20086073993367803, 63 trades)
matrix: 4 branches fixed BEFORE running: {majority_control_1x (1x control + guard reference), U1_1x (1x control), U1_agreeweight (vote sizing), U1_agreeweight_dd_guard (vote x guard)} x 3 scenarios {normal, fee_stress, execution_stress}
